app.name: TCI Auto Zone
app.tagline: Auto parts and accessories — Turks and Caicos Islands

auth.registerHint: Next you will register your company (required step).

companySetup.title: Register company
companySetup.intro: Creates branch, warehouse, chart of accounts, roles and document series. Use demo mode until testing is complete; do not use real customer data yet.
companySetup.regionNote: USD currency · America/Grand_Turk timezone · Set address, logo and taxes later in Settings.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.stage1Done: Stage 1: security, base settings and chart of accounts.
dashboard.demoBanner: Demo mode is on. Do not record real commercial operations until integration tests are complete.
dashboard.now1: Sign in with server-verified roles and permissions (RLS).
dashboard.now2: Edit brand and contact details in Settings (if permitted).
dashboard.now3: View the default chart of accounts and system roles.

settings.title: Company settings
settings.taxPending: Taxes and fiscal data: pending configuration and verification before using real data. The system does not invent rates or legal formats.
settings.logoUrl: Logo URL (host image on your storage or Supabase Storage)
settings.taxIdLabel: Tax ID label (e.g. Tax Registration No.)

printing.title: Printing
printing.subtitle: System dialog and PDF. Printing does not confirm sales or move inventory.
printing.platformWindows: Windows: use installed drivers via the browser print dialog.
printing.platformAndroid: Android: system print; optional RawBT integration in a later phase (no generic ESC/POS).
printing.platformIos: iPhone/iPad: AirPrint when offered in the dialog; PDF download as well.
printing.platformUsb: USB, Bluetooth, Wi‑Fi or LAN depends on device and printer model; universal support is not guaranteed.
printing.saleDecoupled: If printing fails, a confirmed sale is not reversed; you may reprint without duplicating sales.
printing.statusSpooler: Sent to the system spooler (does not confirm paper output).
printing.statusUnknown: Uncertain result: no automatic retry. Verify or reprint manually.
printing.recoveryBody: Some jobs did not finish. Check the printer before reprinting.
printing.recoveryNoAutoRetry: No automatic retry to avoid duplicate copies.

instructions.webSystem: Opens the system dialog. On iPhone/iPad look for AirPrint when supported.
instructions.pdf: Save the PDF and open it with your preferred app.
instructions.electron: Run the desktop app (desktop/ folder) with the frontend running.
instructions.rawbt: Install RawBT on Android. Verify your thermal model compatibility.

pwa.title: PWA install
pwa.notNative: Browser install adds a home screen icon but is not a native app.
pwa.limitUsb: Does not guarantee direct USB printer access from the browser.
pwa.limitBt: Bluetooth and ESC/POS need helper apps or the desktop build.
pwa.usePdf: Use PDF or system print as a stable fallback.
pwa.installHint: Chrome/Edge: menu → Install app. iOS Safari: Share → Add to Home Screen.
pwa.updateAvailable: A new version of TCI Auto Zone is available.
pwa.updateDeferredPos: Update deferred while POS is in use. Finish the sale, then update.

inventory.title: Product and stock intake
inventory.subtitle: For testing: register real products before POS. Receipt updates moving average cost.
inventory.name: Name

pos.title: Point of sale
pos.subtitle: Sale is committed to the database before printing. If print fails, use Reprint COPY.
pos.printFailedSaleSaved: Sale saved. Printing failed; recover via Reprint COPY or PDF.
pos.printQueueFailed: Could not load invoice for printing.
